changes: Restore nearest mapped parent on popup destroy, null attachment or dismissal; synchronize keyboard/text-input/data-device focus and clear stale pointer/grab targets before processing GTK selection.

Cover navigation, editing, F1-F12, modifier masks, ISO and keypad keycodes; translate shifted ASCII punctuation for clients without text-input.
Add a real guest Bridge/UIPasteboard read/write test and original GTK/ARM64 mousepad context-menu regressions.

Only a mapped grabbed popup can receive focus on commit. Keep parent focus after an active popup attaches NULL, and keep parent focus while a new menu is still awaiting its first buffer. Regression first failed with focus=None and now passes with the mapped parent.

diagnosis.clipboard: Original ARM64 mousepad unmaps/destroys its context-menu popup before sending wl_data_device.set_selection. The old compositor kept the focus pointing to that deleted surface, rejected the valid selection and never requested host clipboard.write. Ctrl+C from the mapped parent continued to work.
diagnosis.navigation: UIKit arrow/function strings pass CharacterSet.controlCharacters filtering. The previous code handed them to local UITextInput navigation, so only the mirror selection moved. Subsequent replacement no longer overlapped the guest cursor and was discarded.
